description: Get rate benchmark statistics (min/median/max APR) across all institutions. Use this for market analysis, comparing user quotes against market rates, or building benchmark dashboards. Returns statistics for mortgages (30yr fixed, 15yr fixed, and `mortgage_arm` — one bucket covering every adjustable-rate mortgage regardless of initial fixed period), auto loans (new/used — cars only), RV/boat/motorcycle/powersports (first-class vehicle categories), HELOCs, and personal loans. Each product shows the lowest APR institution, median APR, and count of institutions.

product_type.description: Filter to a specific product type. If omitted, returns benchmarks for all product types.

state.description: Filter to a specific US state (2-letter code). If omitted, returns nationwide benchmarks.

name: get_benchmarks

benchmarks.description: Formatted per-product benchmark rows, one per product category, ready to present.

aprSpread.description: Distance between highest and lowest APR, written out in percentage points; the size of the shopping-around prize.

asOf.description: UTC timestamp of the newest rate behind this product's benchmark.

highestAPR.description: Highest published APR as a percent string.

institutions.description: Number of credit unions publishing this product; small counts make the median and spread unreliable.

lowestAPR.description: Best published APR for this product as a percent string — one outlier deal, not what a typical borrower gets.

lowestAPRProvider.description: Credit union publishing the lowest APR, with its state in parentheses.

medianAPR.description: Median published APR as a percent string; the fairest single number for 'the going rate'.

product.description: Human-readable product this row benchmarks, e.g. 'New Auto Loan (60 months)'.

generatedAt.description: UTC timestamp when this benchmark response was assembled; the underlying rates are older, see each row's asOf.

rawData.description: The same benchmarks as unformatted numbers, for calculation rather than display.

count.description: Number of published offers behind this row's statistics.

displayName.description: Human-readable label for the product category.

medianAPR.description: Median published APR in percent; the robust central number for this product.

minAPR.description: Lowest published APR in percent. Extreme lows can be data artifacts such as promotional or calculator-default values, so sanity-check against medianAPR.

minAPRInstitution.description: Credit union publishing the lowest APR for this product.

minAPRInstitutionId.description: Internal composite identifier 'name|city|STATE' of that lender.

minAPRState.description: Two-letter state code of the lender publishing the lowest APR.

stateFilter.description: Scope of the benchmark set as a label — 'Nationwide' when no state narrowing was applied. Check this before describing the numbers as local.

summary.description: Plain-English headline of the benchmark set, e.g. the range of 30-year fixed APRs and how many credit unions publish them.

totalInstitutions.description: Number of institutions behind the benchmark set, returned as a string rather than a number.
